profiles.description: Monetary cash balances, trade receivables and trade payables. A fixed amount of currency will be received or paid in money; remeasure at the closing exchange rate.
Nonmonetary equipment, inventory and prepaid services held at historical cost. The benefit is goods or services, not a fixed cash receipt; retain the original historical exchange rate.
